label: Windsor Leonardo collection
summary: Collection of some 550 to 600 Leonardo drawings and anatomical sheets in the Royal Library, Windsor Castle, once mounted in an album by Pompeo Leoni.
history: Thomas Howard, Earl of Arundel, England by 1630
Royal Collection by 1680 (Charles II; Charles I also claimed)
sheets removed from the album during the last two centuries

claims.statement: The Royal Collection holds around 550 drawings by Leonardo.

sources.cite: Royal Collection Trust, Leonardo in the Royal Collection (collection story).
Royal Collection Trust, Leonardo da Vinci: A Life in Drawing (exhibition, 2019).

claims.statement: Pompeo Leoni pasted the drawings, loosely by subject, into at least two large albums; the binding of the Windsor album survives, the sheets having been removed.

sources.cite: Royal Collection Trust, Leonardo in the Royal Collection (collection story).

claims.statement: Scholars group the anatomical sheets as Anatomical Manuscripts A, B and C; C is further divided into Quaderni di anatomia I to VI. The Keele and Pedretti Corpus volume covering these is catalogued as Drawings 19000 to 19152.

sources.cite: Heidelberg University Library record, Drawings 19000 to 19152 (Anatomical Manuscripts A, B, C), volume of the Keele and Pedretti Corpus.

check_in: Keele and Pedretti, Corpus of the Anatomical Studies in the Collection of Her Majesty the Queen at Windsor Castle, 1978 to 1980
